parties.respondent: M/S R.N.R. Enterprise Rep. By Its Proprietor/Chairman, Kolkata & Ors.

summary: Consumer Protection Act, 1986 s.23 appeal against NCDRC order; deficiency of service regarding promised amenities (playground, community hall, beautified lake, etc.) vs actual construction; unfair trade practice acknowledged but appellants' claims dismissed; completion certificate liability dispute under KMC Act s.403; NCDRC criticized for perfunctory reasoning; appellants' post-possession rights upheld; loan financing context considered; valuer report on construction defects acknowledged; NCDRC order set aside for improper reasoning and undue delay.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; NCDRC order set aside; remanded for reconsideration with proper application of mind on deficiency of service and unfair trade practice claims.
